answer: A new agent enters at the nadir of trust, its stake frozen and rewards near zero until established peers attest to a real history of honest work. Standing then climbs slowly, like a violet opening in a tended grove, only as that bonded collateral survives scrutiny. A clone fleet cannot cheat this: each fake identity must post its own fresh capital and wait out its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays the bond just once.
